**Finding: missing (medium) — no post-termination transition assistance or data return.**

- **What the document says:** Section 10 covers only access cut-off (10.1), Deliverable delivery and refunds (10.2). Section 10.1 references "any agreed transition period" but no clause creates one.
- **Gap confirmed:** No hits for "transition" assistance obligations, "machine-readable", or any deletion language. Section 16.5 returns/destroys *Confidential Information* but expressly carves out Customer Data to "Sections 11 and 15" — Section 11 does not exist in this Agreement, and Section 15 (Customer Data and Privacy) imposes no return, export or deletion duty. So on termination we would have no contractual route to recover our data.
- **Remedy (validated, ok:true):** New Section 10.3 inserted after 10.2 with the preferred position — up to six months' transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return/export of Customer Data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter (subject to routine backups and legal retention). Fallback of 90 days' assistance with the same 30-day export offered in the comment.
